basic_info.description:
Be the first to live in this never before occupied new bespoke condominium home. Serif 623 newly purchased by owner is being leased for the first time. The building is full of amenities, and is adjacent to the Timbri boutique hotel with a rooftop bar and curated cafe and lobby. Ready access to Muni and BART, and across the street from the Ikea Restaurants Hall filled with a delicious electic mix of dining and bar options.

A lobby concierge attends 24/7 to ensure security and service, with a package room to hold all your deliveries. The first class fitness facility includes cardio, weights, stretching and diverse exercise equipment. On the roof, find a chef's kitchen for entertaining, a lounge for work or play and quiet outdoor space with a view of the City.

Owner is responsible for water and gas, Renter responsible for electric, and setting up cable, Internet services.
